mapper.select: SELECT pc.car_id carId, pc.key_cabinet keyCabinet, pc.key_status keyStatus, pt.start_time startTime, pt.end_time endTime, pt.user_id applicantId FROM pubcar_trip pt LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_car_num ptcn ON ptcn.trip_id = pt.trip_id AND ptcn.status_cd = '0' LEFT JOIN pubcar_car pc ON pc.car_id = ptcn.car_id WHERE ((pt.start_time <= #{startTime} AND pt.end_time >= #{startTime}) OR (pt.start_time <= #{endTime} AND pt.end_time >= #{endTime}) OR (pt.start_time > #{startTime} AND pt.end_time < #{endTime})) AND ptcn.car_id IS NOT NULL AND pt.trip_status <> 3 AND pt.approval_status <> 1 AND pt.status_cd = '0' AND pc.status_cd = '0' AND pc.car_type1 = #{carType} UNION ALL SELECT car_id carId, NULL keyCabinet, NULL keyStatus, NULL startTime, NULL endTime, NULL applicantId FROM pubcar_car WHERE status_cd = '0' AND key_status = 2 AND car_type1 = #{carType}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.car_id) count FROM pubcar_car c LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_car_num n ON n.car_id = c.car_id LEFT JOIN pubcar_trip_mileage m ON m.trip_id = n.trip_id AND m.driver_id = n.driver_id WHERE c.status_cd = '0'
and c.license like concat('%',#{license},'%')
and c.brand like concat('%',#{brand},'%')
and c.model like concat('%',#{model},'%')
and c.asset_num like concat('%',#{assetNum},'%')
and c.department_id = #{departmentId}
and c.community_id = #{communityId}
mapper.insert: insert into business_pubcar_car(color, remark, car_id, license, seat_num, car_type, car_type1, sn_id, key_cabinet, card_number, attr_id, asset_num, insurance_id, model, department_id, community_id, brand, b_id, operate) values (#{color}, #{remark}, #{carId}, #{license}, #{seatNum}, #{carType}, #{carType1}, #{snId}, #{keyCabinet}, #{cardNumber}, #{attrId}, #{assetNum}, #{insuranceId}, #{model}, #{departmentId}, #{communityId}, #{brand}, #{carBId}, #{operate})
